canonical_project: ITEZ Tier III data center (Lviv colocation)
notes: Operator page confirms rack colocation in a Tier III data center in Lviv with 24/7 security, video surveillance, UPS/generators, dual power, 40 Gbit/s uplink channels and DDoS protection; 99.9% uptime claim. De Novo's Kyiv page also references a Lviv DC option, but ITEZ is the directly verified Lviv facility. No public MW capacity published.
